minimumAcceptedEvidenceRule: A displayed score/transcription/video/audio phrase needs exact MIDI agreement between audio-agreed detected notes and verified MusicXML source notes. Pitch letters, OCR/OMR candidates, and source crops alone are not accepted evidence.

sources.basis: Manual source review from the local IMSLP solo-violin score page; used only as symbolic source truth until a matching audio phrase passes the audio gate.

positiveSourcePhrases.basis: This exact MIDI phrase must be discoverable in verified MusicXML, but it is not a live accepted transcription without paired audio agreement.

rejectedRegressionPhrases.basis: Previous false score-map candidate; must not be promoted as Wieniawski source evidence.
User-flagged mismatch where displayed transcription and score did not share the same notes.
Current best live source target is an audio-agreed candidate but does not exist in the verified symbolic score excerpt.
